_note: Site-wide page effects: the fade between pages and the loading screen. Declared here, read by the mu-plugin (brg_fx_settings in vc-clients-embed.php), which hands them to brgw.js as window.BRGW_FX. Defaults are what a page does with nothing saved.

page_fx.label: Page transitions
page_fx.doc: On: clicking a link to another page on this site fades the page content out and lifts it a little (the menu bar stays), then the next page fades in and rises into place. Off: pages change the way a browser normally does. Turn this off first if a link ever misbehaves. Phones and tablets with reduce motion switched on never see it.

loader.label: Loading screen
loader.doc: The bouncing smiley shown while a page loads. Only when the page is slow: it appears if a page has not finished loading after a third of a second, and when you click through to another page. Every page: it always shows while a page loads. Off: never. With Page transitions on and this off, the screen goes blank between pages while the next one loads.

choices.slow: Only when the page is slow

loader_art.label: Loading screen picture
loader_art.doc: What bounces. Leave it empty for the BRG smiley. Any SVG or PNG from the media library works; SVG stays crisp at any size. A shape roughly as wide as it is tall looks best.

loader_bg.label: Loading screen background
loader_bg.doc: The color behind the picture. Black or teal suit the yellow smiley; white suits a dark picture.
